   So after that whole fiasco was over, Nico and Mira were
good kids. We never saw April ever again. We also never saw
Nevaeh again. But there was one problem... Sheila was still
captured.

     But don't worry, there's a brightside to every story. We
woke Sheila before her parents found her. And we all walked
to school the next day, having fixed everything and wiped a
bunch of minds. But we can all agree that there was one
lesson we all wanted to teach people.

    No matter who you are, where you come from, what
your background is... family is family.

     You might feel a little lost, but you should never be
scared to just speak out... there's always at least one person
who understands. And, who knows....

   Maybe you're a little hardly human, too.
